docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Marcel Reuter, CCIE #41476
docs.text:
is an independent network architect at Netomat. Over 10 years experience with large scale telecommunication / Service Provider networks. Deep knowlege of Segment-Routing / MPLS and Datacenter Innovative, open-minded, and adaptable to different work environments. Be able to adopt busines needs into Network-designs My current focus includes desiging Segment-routing networks, network automation with Python and Ansible, networking in public clouds, large-scale data centers. You can find a list of my skills here: Skills You can find a list of my past projects here: Projects

When I am not behind a computer I enjoy the nature on long walks with my dogs or hiking somewhere.

Finance: Datacenter, DMZ-hardening, network architecture, design Backbone and Datacenter. Config hardening with CIS Policy Templates. Technologies: Routing, Switching, Firewalls, MPLS, OSPF, STP Vendors: Cisco IOS-XE, Cisco NXOS, Fortinet, Cisco ACI

Service provider: Holistic Transport network Design. Migration concept testing and development for Merger Mobile backhaul and IP-MPLS core with Segment-routing. Technologies: BGP, ISIS, LDP, MPLS, Segment-routing, PCE, Ansible SW Revision testing, IXIA failover tests Vendors: Juniper MX, Cisco ASR9k, Cisco 8K, Huawei

docs.title: Our services
docs.text:
We are providing services in the following fields

  • Consulting / Engineering Most of our customer projects last from several months to several years and involve a combination of our services.

For example, when creating a network architecture, testing is always necessary to check immediately whether the respective feature works according to the specifications. and how different vendors implemented the same RFC

Our expertise and experience are in the following areas:

  • Network LAN/WAN

  • Data centre

  • VPN SD-WAN

  • Creating of HLD/LLD

  • SW Revision testing
